stem:
Each strip of the diagram is shaded to represent a fraction of 1 whole.

[Diagram showing 1 whole, Strip A divided into 4 parts with 3 shaded, Strip B divided into 8 parts with 6 shaded]

The fractions represented are —

options.label: F
options.text: equivalent, because the shaded area of Strip B is greater than the shaded area of Strip A

options.label: G
options.text: not equivalent, because Strip A has 4 parts in all and Strip B has 8 parts in all

options.label: H
options.text: equivalent, because the shaded area of Strip A is the same as the shaded area of Strip B

options.label: J
options.text: not equivalent, because Strip A has 3 shaded parts and Strip B has 6 shaded parts

visual_elements: strip A divided into 4 parts, 3 shaded
strip B divided into 8 parts, 6 shaded
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding fractions, comparing fraction sizes, and recognizing equivalence by area and number of parts, which involves moderate reasoning beyond simple recall.
